run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a transformer model using MXFP4 GPTQ calibration
create_gptq_modifier: create a GPTQModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with MXFP4A16 quantization scheme
build_preprocess_dataset: build a dataset preprocessing pipeline applying chat templates to message examples

save_compressed_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk with compression enabled
